name: thimble
description: thimble beside a Claude Code session for making sense of a corpus of files. In every session the plugin loads with about 21 tokens (one deferred tool, load_thimble) and starts no server; thimble turns on at the first data-file read, /thimble or a call of load_thimble, and then draws its cards, citations, coverage and checks in the terminal and keeps its panel there. /thimble browser, or a press in the panel, opens the browser workbench (chat, files, a canvas of cards and a report) on the same session, signed in. One MCP server (the thimble tools), one hooks module (hooks/register.ts: the agent bridge and file guard, then the terminal UI), the /thimble skill and the skills of thimble's commands. The orientation, its critic, a writer, the builder and the reviewer of a view, each run of a check and the agent of a code ticket are subagents of the session, of the types the hooks module registers.

viewProposals.title: View proposals
viewProposals.description: After a turn, thimble may propose a view of the files: a page that shows their records in a form the files hide.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels that a model applies to every record of a file, and their lists of records no category fit.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Checks that read Claude's answers and documents and comment on passages, which the terminal highlights.

citationMarks.title: Citation marks
citationMarks.description: A check mark or a red cross on each citation, after thimble checks that the cited place holds the value.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: What Claude read or searched of the data files in this session, under answers and in the panel.

cardCheck.title: Card check
cardCheck.description: After a card is made or changed, a check of its takeaway and its citations against its output.
